outcomes.text: DRAFT. Keepers are paid their gas, a 50,000-gas overhead allowance and 0.0001 ETH per useful call (provisional); the storage refunds they also keep add at most 0.002 ETH per 180 draws.
DRAFT. Restocking fees are fronted, then repaid by winners: fees inside prizes still listed never exceed one board at the 5 gwei cap (55 Shapes x 0.0047 ETH).
DRAFT. Unused restocking fees go to the creator: right after closing, every wei in the Balancer is claimable.
DRAFT. Exact redeemable backing: every prize unlisted redeems for exactly its backing.
DRAFT. The reserve keeps winners paid: after keepers finish, no prize is missing from the board for lack of ETH.
DRAFT. Closeout returns everything: after the closeout the Balancer, its listed backing and its FWA proceeds hold nothing.
DRAFT. The fill gate never blocks the sales that refill prizes: no draw is refused for low inventory while gas is within the 5 gwei cap.
DRAFT. The first 10% of Shape markup goes to the game: profit credited to the creator stays under the markup above 10% (at a 25% markup, 12% of proceeds).
DRAFT. The creator's profit follows the board each draw was priced on: with restocks listed while draws are in flight, profit booked beyond that split stays under 0.001 ETH per 180 draws.
